title: La Commedia, an intimate club on 52nd Street
summary: She worked La Commedia, a smart little intimate club across from Billie Holiday at the Onyx.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Oh, I wanted to ask you, did you ever -- were you ever performing on 52nd Street when that --
Mr. -- what was that man's name? Mr. Fox?
Yeah. Oh, that was one of the smart, little intimate clubs. Right across the street from Billie.
Yes. Right across the street from where she worked.
What was it, the Onyx, or --
Yes. The Onyx. Uh-huh. And Mr. -- no, his name wasn't Fox. Mr. Schwartz. No. I'll think of

his name, maybe, later. But it was La Commedia, and that was one of them smart little clubs, little intimate clubs. That's what we had, didn't we? Oh, Chris, we had that years ago, little smart, intimate clubs, where the people would come in and sit and talk and laugh, and no dancing or anything like that. Just an intimate little club.
